import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1]
    
    maxWordLength = 0
    wordCountOutside = 0
    currentWordLength = 0
    inBracketMode = False
    
    for ch in s:
        if ch == '(':
            maxWordLength = max(maxWordLength, currentWordLength)
            currentWordLength = 0
            inBracketMode = True
        elif ch == ')':
            if currentWordLength > 0:
                wordCountOutside += 1
            currentWordLength = 0
            inBracketMode = False
        elif ch == '_':
            if inBracketMode:
                if currentWordLength > 0:
                    wordCountOutside += 1
            else:
                maxWordLength = max(maxWordLength, currentWordLength)
            currentWordLength = 0
        else:
            currentWordLength += 1
    
    maxWordLength = max(maxWordLength, currentWordLength)
    print(f"{maxWordLength} {wordCountOutside}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
